summary: The retry loop is sound, but the context deadline is not propagated to the downstream call.

comments.body: The retry loop calls c.do(context.Background(), req) rather than passing the caller's ctx, so a cancelled request keeps retrying.

suggestions.summary: Pass the caller's context straight through

comments.body: No test covers cancellation mid-retry, which is why the dropped context above went unnoticed at review time.

suggestions.summary: Add a case that cancels after the first attempt
